card.name: Embryo-fetal toxicity and testing headings
card.fires_on: The second part of section headings or phrases in warnings, such as the 'etal' in Embryo-Fetal Toxicity, 'Tests' in Laboratory Tests, and 'testing' after pregnancy. Also 'harm' after 'fetal'.

modes.label: Embryo-Fetal heading

modes.label: Fetal harm
modes.description: The word 'harm' right after 'fetal' in statements about pregnant women.
modes.example: IDHIFA can cause fetal<< harm>>. Advise patients of the potential risk

modes.label: Testing headings
modes.description: 'testing' or 'Tests' ending a heading or instruction about pregnancy or laboratory checks.
modes.example: Laboratory<< Tests>> Because serious GI tract ulcerations and bleeding
